answer: Sample a random 5% of submissions each epoch and recompute them from the original inputs. Tax any attestation batch where signers share a subnet. Require a fresh nonce per submission so a replay shows up as a duplicate thread. Follow the spiral of referrals two hops and void payouts that loop back. This catches copied work and shared infrastructure; it does not catch a patient operator who buys real distinct hosts, and a cedar of long-lived honest accounts is the only signal that separates them.
